Three.js 0.187.0 (MIT), from the official npm tarball:
https://registry.npmjs.org/three/-/three-0.187.0.tgz

The tarball SHA-512 was verified against npm's `dist.integrity` before extraction.
`three.js` bundles the scene's selected exports from build/three.module.js using esbuild, minified as ES2022 ESM.
The preview serves this locally and makes no CDN requests.

Retain THREE-LICENSE.txt when redistributing this bundle.
